description:
Refit Filters (Weapon Class) 3.2.7

For Starsector 0.98a

A fork of Starficz's

Refit Filters

. It keeps everything the original does (search bar, projectile/beam, PD, ammo and damage type filters, range slider) and adds one more row to the refit weapon picker:

Weapon Class

.

Download

Direct link:

RefitFiltersWeaponClass.zip

(GitHub). The TriOS button installs the mod and its two libraries in one click (TriOS 1.6.0 or newer).

Source:

github.com/Sztarek/starsector-refit-filter-mod

Supports Version Checker and TriOS.

What the Weapon Class row does

One button per class of weapon you actually own. The row is built from your fleet cargo, from local storage when you are docked, and from whatever the picker is listing for the slot. Own weapons from three factions, get three buttons. Pick up a fourth, get a fourth.Click a button to show only that class. Shift or Ctrl + click adds another class. Clicking the last active button turns the whole row back on. Reset Filters, Ctrl + R and middle mouse reset it like the other rows.Hover a button to see how many weapons of that class are in the list and how many you own.Big mod lists stay manageable: only a few rows of buttons show at once (3 by default), and the rest are paged with the < > buttons in the header or the mouse wheel over the row. HIDE collapses the buttons to the header row; your filters stay active while hidden.The row only appears once the picker has at least one weapon to classify, so an empty cargo costs no space.

Grouping

The BY button in the header switches what counts as a class, and the choice is remembered:

Design Type (default): the weapon's design type / manufacturer. Weapons with no design type fall back to the mod they come from.Source Mod: the mod the weapon comes from.

The row's position (1 to 5, or 0 to disable) and how many rows of buttons show at once are on the LunaLib settings page.

Requirements

LazyLib 3.0.0+LunaLib 2.0.0+

Install and compatibility

Extract the zip into your mods folder and enable it. This replaces Refit Filters: enable one or the other, not both. If both are enabled, the fork detects it and stands down. Utility mod: safe to add to or remove from an existing save.

Changelog

Spoiler3.2.7

- The class row now also works in the fighter wing picker.

3.2.6

- Fixed class filtering with more than one page of classes: a plain click now means only this class across all pages.

3.2.5

- The class row no longer grows without limit: at most a set number of rows show at once (default 3, LunaLib setting), the rest are paged with < > buttons or the mouse wheel.

- Added a HIDE / SHOW button that collapses the class buttons to the header row. Filters stay active while hidden; the choice is remembered.

3.2.4

- Fixed both mods going dead when this fork and the original were enabled together. The fork now stands down on its own as intended.

3.2.3

- Removed the Weapon Type grouping, the vanilla slot filter already covers it.

3.2.2

- Own mod id (refitfilters_weaponclass). The fork stands down if the original Refit Filters is enabled alongside it.

3.2.1

- The grouping switch moved from the LunaLib settings page into the filter row itself.

3.2.0

- Added the Weapon Class filter row, built dynamically from owned weapons (cargo + docked storage) and the picker list.

- Class grouping: Design Type or Source Mod.

- Filter row order settings now go up to 5.

- Based on Refit Filters 3.1.3.

[close]

Credits and license

Refit Filters and its UI framework are by Starficz. The filter code is CC0-1.0 and the UI framework is LGPL-3.0 (full license texts included; the fork renames the packages so it can coexist with the original). The Weapon Class filter is CC0-1.0 as well. See the LICENSE file in the mod.

AI disclosure

The Weapon Class filter in this fork was vibe coded.
